parsed.summary: Lumen Cells's 60 kWh battery pack shipment SH-0248 to Wacky Wheels Huntsville slips from 2027-03-29 to 2027-04-01. 3 affected production orders were moved to the earliest free slots with 3 rescheduled and 0 transferred. 18 dealers were each notified once for 29 customer orders, and 7 Platinum/Gold customers received loaners within pool limits.
parsed.decision_reason: Acted on a real incident of type supplier_delay because IDs and dates resolved against the data, rehearsal on the digital twin passed with zero failures, and live baseline matched before the first write.
